_readme: Haus Ravenmark — a WORKED EXAMPLE of a third-party haus pack.
It ships nothing of the game's: its own sigil, its own half-helm, its own
crest, its own taunts. Copy this folder into user://hauses/ and it plays.
The format, the rules and the reasons: docs/HAUS-PACK.md
name: Haus Ravenmark

game_start: Corvenhold counts your pieces. It is a short count.
The birds came early. They know the hour.
We are counted at dusk. You will be counted sooner.
Move. The flock is patient and the field is wide.
Every banner ends as feathers and a field.
You will hear us before you see us. Then only us.
The ravens have already chosen their perches.
Play, and let the counting begin.
player_captured: Your {piece} is carrion now, and we are punctual.
The flock thanks you for the {piece}.
We keep no prisoners, only tallies.
rival_captured: A bird falls. The flock does not.
You took a {piece}. The count still favours us.
One perch empty. There are a thousand.
We mourn in flight, not in place.
Take the {piece}. The field remains ours.
Blood on the branch. It has been there before.
check_given: Your king stands under a full tree.
Look up. That is the last thing they all do.
There is nowhere a bird cannot follow.
Dusk, and the flock has your scent.
check_received: A stone thrown into a tree changes nothing.
The flock scatters and reforms. Watch.
Noise is not the same as harm.
We are counted at dusk, not now.
Ravens are not so easily scattered.
You have our attention. It is not a gift.
The tree still stands, and so do we.
game_end: The field is quiet, and the birds are not.
You were counted. That is all any of us get.
Sleep. The flock keeps the field.
It is done, and the branches are full.
